item.title: Church Closed Temporarily For Safety Reasons
item.description: Market Harborough Baptist Church has temporarily closed after an electrical survey found a number of serious faults. The Coventry Road building will be out of use for two to three months while essential repairs are carried out. During the closure Sunday services will move to the Jubilee Hall at the Congregational Church on Bowden Lane […]

item.title: Taxis Firm Closes After Over 50 Years In Market Harborough
item.description: A long-standing Market Harborough taxi firm has ceased trading after running into financial difficulties. Murphys Taxis, which was first established in the town in the early 1970s, has closed with the loss of a number of jobs and is set to enter voluntary liquidation. item.title: Plans Announced To Demolish Derelict Factory
item.description: North Northamptonshire Council has announced plans to demolish the former Lawrences Factory in Desborough over safety concerns. The historic building has stood derelict for nearly 30 years, is structurally unsound, and attracts high levels of anti-social behaviour. item.description: Police are investigating after a thief broke into a car in Market Harborough and used stolen bank cards in local shops. item.description: A woman has been arrested on suspicion of drink driving following a crash in Market Harborough this morning. item.title: HDC Could Become Only Council To Cut Council Tax
item.description: Harborough District Council could become the only local authority in the country to reduce council tax, under proposals to be discussed by its Cabinet.
